teaser: You straighten the row of chairs before anyone asks why they were crooked. Life path 11 is called the illuminator, a path built on inspiration and high standards; ESTJ is the type built on order, the one who runs the room before the room asks for a captain. Crossed, the vision eleven carries does not stay a feeling — it gets a schedule, a checklist, a chain of command. What's particular here is a hunch dressed in a clipboard: something quietly sensed and then made structural, before most people have noticed anything is happening at all.
